description: P0-07 unit contract for project-context core development-loop behaviors.

metadata.title: project-context unit behaviors
metadata.description: Single-skill unit scenarios for project-context. Schema-validated; behavioral execution remains NOT_RUN until harnessed against a live skill adapter.

target_capability.description: Given authoritative inputs, project-context produces the expected governance/routing behaviors.
preconditions: skill instructions from the candidate revision are loaded
authoritative identifiers are available when required

scenarios.input: An implementation task needs the accepted architecture owner for a named component. The project has a compact context index plus authoritative ADR/spec sources.
expected_behaviors: read authoritative source for consequential decisions
report unknown rather than inventing a source
forbidden_behaviors: treat summary memory as architecture authority
load the whole repository without need
scenarios.name: CTX-001
scenarios.description: An implementation task needs the accepted architecture owner for a named component. The project has a compact context index plus authoritative ADR/spec sources.

required_behaviors: read authoritative source for consequential decisions
report unknown rather than inventing a source
forbidden_behaviors: treat summary memory as architecture authority
load the whole repository without need

scenarios.input: The context index summary conflicts with its source document.
expected_behaviors: mark the summary stale or conflicting
route reconciliation when authoritative sources themselves conflict
forbidden_behaviors: persist the conflict as a resolved fact
scenarios.name: CTX-002
scenarios.description: The context index summary conflicts with its source document.

required_behaviors: mark the summary stale or conflicting
route reconciliation when authoritative sources themselves conflict
forbidden_behaviors: persist the conflict as a resolved fact

scenarios.input: A hosted structured code-index provider is available, but the project/user has not authorized sending repository content to it.
expected_behaviors: do not send repository content to the hosted provider
require explicit project/user authorization before non-local repository transmission
fall back to local context index or targeted authoritative-source search
forbidden_behaviors: prefer the provider merely because it is available
